Uses of Package
org.aristonis.diwan.database

Packages that use org.aristonis.diwan.database
Package
Description
org.aristonis.diwan.database
Defines the Connection API every part of Diwan Database sends SQL through.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.android
Android support: a driver over Android's own SQLiteDatabase, for Android 9 (API 28) and later, where JDBC is not available.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver
Defines the interface a database driver implements for Diwan Database.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent
Eloquent models: one class per table over the query builder, in the style of Laravel's Eloquent.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.exception
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.page
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.scope
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.event
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager
Builds named connections from configuration the first time they are used and hands out the query, schema and migrator objects of each.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations
Migrations: schema changes written as classes, and the table that records which ones ran.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql
PostgreSQL support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into PostgreSQL SQL, the query grammar and processor, and a migration lock built on advisory locks.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query
The query builder: build reads and writes fluently and compile them to SQL for one database.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema
Schema building: describe tables with a Blueprint and run them through a Schema.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding
Runs seeders: classes that fill a database with starting data.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.sqlite
SQLite support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into SQLite SQL, and the query grammar and processor that run the query builder on SQLite.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing
Test support: a JUnit 5 extension that gives every test a clean database, and assertions on database rows and models.
  • Classes in org.aristonis.diwan.database used by org.aristonis.diwan.database
    Class
    Description
    Connection
    Sends SQL to one database and manages transactions on it.
    ConnectionBuilder
    Configures and builds a root Connection; obtained from Connection.builder().
    Expression
    A piece of SQL written into a statement exactly as given and never bound: count(*) in a select list or now() as a value in a query, or a default value computed by the database in a schema.
    Internal
    Marks a type or member that is not part of the public API and may change in any release.
    LoggedQuery
    Records one statement and its bindings, as captured by Connection.pretend(PretendCallback).
    PretendCallback
    Runs work whose SQL is recorded instead of sent to the database.
    QueryKind
    Tells which Connection method ran a statement.
    TransactionCallback
    Runs work inside a transaction and returns its result.
    TransactionOptions
    Settings of one outermost transaction: how long it waits for a lock and how many times it runs.
    TransactionScope
    Holds a transaction open until it is committed or closed, for use with try-with-resources.
